record_title: Pairwise incidence rigidity for transitive hypersurface families
limitations: The theorem concerns unoriented transitive families of closed embedded hypersurfaces in dimensions at least three. It does not treat arbitrary oriented transitive families, higher multiple intersections, quantitative angle estimates, or the intrinsic geometry of the pair intersection. The n=1 case is excluded. The motivating preprint is very recent, so later revisions or unindexed parallel observations remain a residual originality risk.
